question: Where’s the closest fast food restaurant lying along the route toward Planet Word, Washington, DC from Mario & Alberto De La Cruz Art Gallery, Washington, DC?
sql: SELECT P.poi_name FROM pois AS P WHERE P.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects( P.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mario & Alberto De La Cruz Art Gallery%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Planet Word%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 100 -- 100 meter buffer around the straight line path ) ) ORDER BY P.geometry::geography <-> ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Planet Word%' LIMIT 1 )::geography LIMIT 1;
